relationships.subject: Melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: the protective effects of melatonin were achieved through activation of the Sirt1 pathway and downregulation of the NLRP3 inflammasome

relationships.subject: Sirt1
relationships.evidence_quote: melatonin could attenuate prostate inflammation and pelvic pain by inhibiting the NLRP3 inflammasomes signaling pathway through the activation of Sirt1 in mice with EAP

relationships.subject: Melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: the histological appearance of the prostate tissues, pelvic pain development, and the levels of proinflammatory cytokines were significantly alleviated

key_findings: Melatonin alleviates prostatitis and pelvic pain in EAP mice via Sirt1 activation and NLRP3 inflammasome suppression
